nodes.label: Client-generated UUIDv7 ids and idempotent POST
Refresh token rotation with 60 s idempotent retry window
nodes.rationale: A response lost on an unstable network must not revoke the device; replay later or after use of the new token is treated as theft.

nodes.label: device_revoked 401 with reason
nodes.rationale: Only an explicit revoke signal wipes local data; plain 401 just refreshes, so old clients degrade safely.

nodes.label: Deterministic fake salt for unknown email in prelogin
Signup limits: DS_SIGNUP, daily limit, 1 GB new-user quota
Author type (server-set: user / guest / agent)
nodes.rationale: Author is set by the server from the sender, not trusted from the client; guest author id is an opaque hash so the share id (which grants a guest token) never leaks.

nodes.label: Everything shared belongs to the owner (quota)
Owner confirmation for accounts created after invite
nodes.rationale: Email is not verified at signup, so the owner must confirm before the key is delivered.

nodes.label: pendingSinceVersion
nodes.rationale: Lets any owner device resume an interrupted key rotation without an extra key version.

nodes.label: Participant agents in shared agent-mode notebooks (D-54 amendment)
Move notebook into / out of shared space
spaceKeyVersion in POST /notebooks
nodes.rationale: A notebook created during a space key rotation would otherwise stay under the old key.

nodes.label: account_changed notifications over sync socket (D-62)
nodes.rationale: Owner complained invitations appeared only after restart and space notebooks after minutes; timer polling remains as fallback.

nodes.label: Voice access by admin and monthly minutes (600/120)
Voice errors: voice_disabled, voice_quota, voice_too_long, voice_upstream, voice_unavailable
DS_VOICE_PROXY outbound proxy for ElevenLabs/OpenRouter
nodes.rationale: Server is in Russia; only voice calls go via an HTTP CONNECT proxy, TLS stays end-to-end to the service.

nodes.label: Voice storage: only voice_access and voice_usage counters
scribe_v1 fallback for 10 minutes after upstream error

hyperedges.label: Live account_changed flow across server, sync contract and clients
